DICEVISION.Settings.SessionCode.Name: Session Code
DICEVISION.Settings.SessionCode.Hint: 8-character code from DiceVision Settings (e.g. XKRM-4N7B). Create one at dicevision.dirtyowlbear.com
DICEVISION.Settings.Mode.Name: Operating Mode
DICEVISION.Settings.Mode.Hint: How recognized dice rolls are handled in Foundry. Replace: every roll (/roll, character sheets) waits for your physical dice while connected; Core › Dice Configuration can still set individual die types to another method.
DICEVISION.Settings.Mode.Replace: Replace — Use physical dice for Foundry rolls
DICEVISION.Settings.Continuous.Name: Continuous Mode
DICEVISION.Settings.Continuous.Hint: Chat mode only. Post every physical roll to chat. Keeps the DiceVision dashboard capturing continuously. When off, use the dice button by the chat box (or /dv roll) to ask for one roll at a time.
DICEVISION.Settings.AutoConnect.Name: Auto-Connect
DICEVISION.Settings.AutoConnect.Hint: Automatically connect to DiceVision when the world loads.
DICEVISION.Settings.ChatVisibility.Name: Chat Visibility
DICEVISION.Settings.ChatVisibility.Hint: Who can see DiceVision roll messages in chat.
DICEVISION.Settings.RollLabel.Name: Roll Label
DICEVISION.Settings.RollLabel.Hint: Label displayed on DiceVision roll messages in chat.
DICEVISION.Notifications.InvalidSession: DiceVision: Invalid or expired session code
DICEVISION.Notifications.MaxReconnect: DiceVision: Connection lost. Check your session code in module settings.
DICEVISION.Notifications.DisplayFailed: DiceVision: Roll received but could not be posted to chat ({error}). See the console for details.
DICEVISION.Notifications.ModeOff: DiceVision: Mode is set to Off. Change it to Replace or Chat in module settings (or /dv mode replace) to use physical dice.
DICEVISION.Notifications.ReplaceMode: DiceVision: in Replace mode, just roll in Foundry (e.g. /roll 1d20 or a character sheet) and it will wait for your physical dice.
DICEVISION.Notifications.NotConnected: DiceVision: Not connected. Check your session code in module settings, or use /dv connect <code>.
DICEVISION.Notifications.ConnectFailed: DiceVision: Could not connect ({error}). Check your session code.
DICEVISION.Notifications.CommandFailed: DiceVision: {command} failed ({error}). See the console for details.
DICEVISION.Controls.CancelRequest: DiceVision: waiting for dice (click to cancel)
DICEVISION.Controls.ContinuousActive: DiceVision: continuous mode is posting every roll
DICEVISION.Commands.Help:
DiceVision commands
/dv roll — post your next physical roll
/dv cancel — cancel a pending roll
/dv continuous [on|off] — post every roll
/dv mode off|chat|replace
/dv connect <code>
/dv disconnect
/dv status
DICEVISION.Commands.NothingToCancel: DiceVision: no roll request to cancel.
DICEVISION.Commands.InvalidCode: DiceVision: "{code}" isn't a session code. Codes are 8 letters or digits, e.g. XKRM-4N7B.
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.Label: DiceVision (physical dice)
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.Waiting: DiceVision: roll {dice} in front of your camera. Submit rolls the rest digitally.
DICEVISION.Fulfillment.NotConnected: DiceVision is not connected. Click Submit to roll digitally.
